batch_title: Subterranean Deep-Core Autonomous Expansion & Living Cavern Ecosystem
overview: Deepen subterranean simulation dynamics, fluid physics, and pawn emotional social texture.

tasks.title: Multi-Z Magma & Groundwater Hydrodynamic Simulation
tasks.architectural_spec: Zero-heap 64x64x3 cellular automaton fluid solver tracking pressure, viscosity, and thermal transfer.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Water meeting magma creates solid obsidian blocks; flood containment bulkheads prevent drowning.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Dwarf Fortress-grade catastrophic tension when mining near subterranean water tables or lava pockets.

tasks.title: Pneumatic Logistics Tube Network & Auto-Sorter Splitters
tasks.architectural_spec: High-velocity pressurized pneumatic delivery chutes connecting Z-1 mining shafts to surface stockpiles.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Items travel at 8.0 tiles/sec; filter splitters sort iron from plasteel automatically.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Factorio-style industrial satisfaction watching goods rocket through glass pneumatic tubes.

tasks.title: Colonist Social Relationships, Banter & Cavern Recreation Loops
tasks.architectural_spec: Granular social opinion matrix, shared cavern leisure activities (playing chess, brewing lichen ale).
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Pawns develop friendships and rivalries; impressiveness of dining rooms grants major mood buffs.
tasks.player_fun_impact: RimWorld-level emotional attachment to colonists; eliminates spreadsheet sterility completely.

tasks.title: Subterranean Fungal Hydroponics & Bioluminescent Flora Farming
tasks.architectural_spec: Nutrient solution circulation system with automatic growth stages, spore collection, and medicinal herbs.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Hydroponic basins produce glow-fungus every 180 ticks; temperature drops pause growth without killing crops.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Vibrant visual bioluminescent farms replacing drab industrial blocks.

tasks.title: Dyson Beam Receiver Focal Beam Lens Flare & Atmospheric Particle Ionization
tasks.architectural_spec: Real-time Vulkan compute shader rendering orbital laser refraction, ground scorching, and atmospheric heat haze.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Engaging Module 120 illuminates entire cavern with dynamic pulsing god-rays at 144+ FPS.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Awe-inspiring visual payoff for endgame victory, wowing the player at first glance.
